outline: 介紹計算機演算法的設計與分析,內容包含了: 函數成長, 遞迴關係, 排序及序列統計, 基礎與進階資料結構, 動態規劃, 貪婪演算法, 搜尋, 圖形與幾何演算法, 字串比對, NP-completeness, 近似演算法, 及平行與分散式演算法.
schedule:
Introduction (1 hrs)
Mathematics for Algorithms (6 hrs)
Data Structures (5 hrs)
Searching (3 hrs)
Divide-and-Conquer (3 hrs)
Sorting and Selection (6 hrs)
Midterm (3 hrs)
Greedy Algorithms (5 hrs)
Dynamic Programming (7 hrs)
Text Searching (5 hrs)
P and NP (7 hrs)
Final Exam (3 hrs)
assessment:
Assignments (40%): 7-9 homework sets
Midterm (25%)
Final exam (35%)
